name: line-shadow-text
title: Line Shadow Text
description: A headline with a hatched drop shadow: an offset copy filled with fine diagonal stripes that crawl slowly (15 s per tile pass).

moworks.author: magicui

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Registry keyframe line-shadow: background-position 0 0 -> 100% -100%, 15 s linear infinite. Demo style as upstream (italic, semibold, tight tracking), with a wider offset and tile so the hatch reads in a small preview.
